items.name: Prefilter
items.summary: A prefilter for accelerating regex searches.

methods.name: find
methods.signature: fn find(&self, haystack: &[u8], span: Span) -> Option<Span>
methods.summary: Run this prefilter on `haystack[span.start..end]` and return a matching span if one exists.

methods.name: from_hir_prefix
methods.summary: This attempts to extract prefixes from the given `Hir` expression for the given match semantics, and if possible, builds a prefilter for them.

methods.name: from_hirs_prefix
methods.signature: fn from_hirs_prefix<H: Borrow<Hir>>(kind: MatchKind, hirs: &[H]) -> Option<Prefilter>
methods.summary: This attempts to extract prefixes from the given `Hir` expressions for the given match semantics, and if possible, builds a prefilter for them.

methods.name: is_fast
methods.summary: Implementations might return true here if they believe themselves to be "fast." The concept of "fast" is deliberately left vague, but in practice this usually corresponds to whether it's believed that SIMD will be used.

methods.name: max_needle_len
methods.summary: Return the length of the longest needle in this Prefilter

methods.name: memory_usage
methods.summary: Returns the heap memory, in bytes, used by the underlying prefilter.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new<B: AsRef<[u8]>>(kind: MatchKind, needles: &[B]) -> Option<Prefilter>
methods.summary: Create a new prefilter from a sequence of needles and a corresponding match semantics.

methods.name: prefix
methods.signature: fn prefix(&self, haystack: &[u8], span: Span) -> Option<Span>
methods.summary: Returns the span of a prefix of `haystack[span.start..span.end]` if the prefilter matches.
